output_list.criticism: The randomness function randMod is used in the buyItem function. The output of randMod is used to determine the price of the item. If the same item is bought multiple times, the price of the item will always be the same. This makes it easier for attackers to predict and buy the same items at the same price. The attacker can use the same input to get the same output. This can be exploited to gain unfair advantage in the game.
